module_cut: epoch-multidimensional-parallel-core: The Cartesian-communicator setup and dynamic load-balancing logic is a genuinely dimension-parametrized infrastructure component: identical algorithmic role (decompose global grid -> local subdomains -> rebalance under load) is re-implemented per dimensionality in mpi_routines.F90/balance.F90 across epoch1d/2d/3d, and it can be exercised/measured independently of any physics package by any input deck that triggers load balancing. Human-approved widening to match PR #341: halo/subtype exchange and inter-rank particle migration are in scope alongside decomposition and DLB.
